newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 707,800 MT were one-tenth above the previous week and the 4-week average.

Major increases for the Netherlands (133,800 MT, includes 83,500 in new sales, 50,300 in destination changes), Spain (111,400 MT, includes 30,000 in new sales, 81,400 in destination changes), Japan (91,400 MT), Mexico (88,900 MT), Belgium (61,500 MT, includes 2,600 in new sales, 30,000 in destination changes), and China (58,300 MT, includes 3,700 in new sales and 55,000 in destination changes ) were partially offset by reductions for unknown (63,700 MT) and Germany (53,000 MT).

Exports of 1,044,500 MT were 72 percent above the previous week and exceeded the 4-week average by 18 percent. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (190,900 MT), China (147,400 MT), Japan (126,200 MT), Spain (111,400 MT), and Mexico (98,900 MT).
